title: A garden made of paper
alt: Coral flowers, folded birds and miniature paper landscapes surround a Chinese exhibition programme.
description: A complete exhibition programme integrated into dimensional paper art, with long Chinese copy and delicate material detail.
prompt:
A richly designed Chinese art exhibition poster. Elaborate folded-paper flowers, delicate paper birds and miniature books form a sculptural garden around the typography. Exquisite cut edges, soft layered shadows, coral orange, teal, pale green and ivory. A large title and three clearly separated paragraphs use crisp Chinese lettering.
The complete text on the page reads: “纸上花园” “让想象开出新的花” “一场关于纸张、色彩与手工的展览” “折出一片森林” “从一张纸开始，寻找形状之间的无限可能。” “收藏一束春天” “让花瓣、叶脉与光影，在指尖重新生长。” “写下一个故事” “把日常的小小发现，装进亲手制作的书。” “周末十点至十八点” “河岸艺术空间 · 欢迎慢慢参观”. Render only this quoted copy, with natural line breaks and clear, correct lettering. No extra words.
